aurc_definition: mean retained-subset MAE across retained sizes k=1,...,N
bootstrap_scope: held-out endpoint sampling variability conditional on the frozen trained model and frozen operating policy
fd002_risk_representation_note: official scoring CSV risk used for post-hoc ranking; difference from pre-label decision CSV is bounded by one float64 machine epsilon in observed data, with identical risk ordering and identical frozen decisions
matched_random_baseline: Monte-Carlo random subsets with exactly the frozen accepted count
risk_coverage_definition: ascending frozen reliability risk; outcome-independent endpoint-ID tie break
